role: minimal availability and service-obligation contract with two physical fixtures; no historical controller development run
registration_context: primary-source information-contract review complete; V1-V5 fixed-request negatives known; no new availability-aware historical outcomes observed

retained_asset.capacity_scope: unchanged analyst unit split and conservative site constraint; no historical converter rating inferred

contract_work: Separate gate-closed baseline, causal availability declaration, request proposal, admitted dispatch and unmet service; define update times and observable state for each
Compute the available pulse envelope from own simulated inventory and frozen physical limits; historical PN/MEL/MIL without publication vintages remain retrospective only
Apply the shared gross site limit to joint unit admissions, not just independent envelopes
Hold the service obligation fixed independently of a policy reducing its declared availability; record both unmet MW and gross directional unmet energy, with no netting between units
A physically safe partial dispatch is still a service failure when the fixed request cannot be supplied; rejected requests do not become successful observations
State that any new proposal-to-dispatch mapping is a simulation assumption; historical BOAs do not identify dispatch under changed baselines and declarations

fixtures.pulse: one-minute linear ramp from zero, 30-minute hold, one-minute linear return; explicit fixture shape consistent with the 2024 OTF duration description, not an inferred hardware ramp limit
fixtures.purpose: check exact gross energy, independent stock bounds, coupled site limit and honest shortfall accounting in symmetric and unequal-stock cases
fixtures.scope: zero-baseline component fixtures only; do not treat them as validation of nonzero baselines, pending BOAs or a historical-week controller

decision: if fixture or accounting fails, repair the contract before integration; if it passes, specify nonzero-baseline and pending-commitment behavior and freeze a bounded causal pilot before observing its results. Do not start a library matrix or source comparison on fixture success
